$comment: Dependency-audit policy for scripts/audit_npm.py. Any advisory at or above
failOnSeverity blocks CI unless an entry here matches the OBSERVED advisory
exactly: id, package, severity, scope, installedVersion and affectedRange.
A severity escalation or any metadata drift blocks and forces re-review, so
an entry cannot approve something other than what was assessed. Entries
expire; an expired or stale entry is itself a CI failure.
